Hypoxanthine ameliorates diet-induced insulin resistance by improving hepatic lipid metabolism and gluconeogenesis via AMPK/mTOR/PPARα pathway. Insulin resistance (IR) is a pivotal metabolic disorder associated with type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome. This study investigated the potential of hypoxanthine (Hx), a purine metabolite and uric acid precursor, in ameliorating IR and regulating hepatic glucose and lipid metabolism. Impact of Imperata Cylindrica polysaccharide on liver lipid metabolism disorders caused by hyperuricemia. Elevated uric acid levels are associated with lipid metabolism disorders. The effects of Imperata cylindrica polysaccharide (ICPC-a) were explored using a hyperuricemia mouse model and a uric acid-induced HepG2 hepatocyte model.
